summary: Payment gateway product reportedly built on NMI's gateway platform for merchants to accept card payments.
access_note: Could not find any Paygent-branded docs; the underlying NMI gateway works only through its partner channel and does not onboard individual merchants.
blocker_note: No public Paygent Connect developer docs found; NMI says it operates exclusively through a partner channel.

evidence.quote: Authentication across our APIs is done via secure API keys.
NMI operates exclusively through a partner channel. We don’t directly onboard individual merchants as end users.
For new integrations, start with the Payment Component and NMI REST API guides, API reference, SDKs, and recipes.
It runs locally on your machine and talks to the NMI REST API with your own merchant API key.

notes: 'Paygent Connect' could not be matched to a vendor site; the hint says NMI-powered, so the profile describes the NMI gateway. Pass 1 missed that NMI publishes its own MCP (npm @nmipayments/nmi-mcp, local, read-only record lookups with a merchant API key) plus a hosted Developer Docs MCP. NMI's FAQ quote ('operates exclusively through a partner channel') could not be re-fetched because www.nmi.com blocks scripts; kept from pass 1 as unverified. Merchant API keys come from the Merchant Portal, which requires a merchant account created through an NMI partner.
